answer: Beacon heartbeats stop bulk fakes. Each epoch a beacon emits an unpredictable signal, and each identity must answer in ten minutes with a heartbeat. Missed or duplicated heartbeats mean suspension. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 machines at 5 credits each, 5,000 a round, above the 800-credit reward, so it loses money. An honest agent pays one heartbeat, keeps its undiluted reward; a voyage seen from a knoll leaves fakes nowhere to hide.
